status: documented fields only; no validator in this scaffold

upstream.note: Same idea as sayframe typed source edits: order and display changes bind to real segment ids. TalkCut adds rough-cut reasons and a motion preset slot.

stage: Accepted only after the user confirms a direction. Rough cut writes this document. Motion and finish read the same project revision.

fields.summary: what this edit changes, in the user's language
fields.revision: revision string from the latest read; stale revisions are rejected
fields.order: optional. Kept segment ids in final order, no duplicates. Ids left out stay in the source and can be restored. This does not destroy media.

removeSpans.reason: breath | silence | filler | repeat | pre-hook | off-task

subtitles.text: display correction only; does not delete or replace audio

settings.captionsEnabled: boolean, independent of the title overlay
settings.title: accurate short title, prefer 28 characters, hard max 120

credibilityNameplate.text: 资格背书词 shown on the nameplate, or empty

settings.musicVolume: number 0 to 1, default low enough that speech stays clear
settings.musicPreset: motion-pack presets/bgm id, or null until stage 3 locks a template
settings.motionTemplate: approved motion-pack preset id, or null
settings.speed: number 0.5 to 2, default 1; do not speed up just to shorten the hook

removeSpansNote: Documented for the future rough cut. The scaffold does not delete audio. A later port should refuse cuts the speech engine cannot prove, and should prefer keeping human breaths over a machine-gun jump cut.
forbidden: Model-supplied audio timestamps, shell commands, asset download URLs, credentials, and example ids used as if they belonged to the current media.
revisionRule: apply must send the revision from the latest read. If it does not match, read again and do not overwrite.
